capabilities: render live dashboards from the Ferusnet tenant tools API in a tabbed custom view
display service data as tables, badges, bar charts and status tiles
store the Kaos API key in the OS-native keychain instead of data.json
optionally read vault notes for context or write reports back via a vault-access mode
revoke leaked API keys through the Ferus agent
extras: Only functional for members of the Ferusnet organisation; the README states it will do nothing useful for anyone else. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Beta/pre-release versions are available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display live metrics from external business services, so users must leave the vault to check operational dashboards.
